note: The road to the platinum in five stages, built from the official trophy descriptions and the PowerPyx roadmap (difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, one playthrough, no online trophies). Cheats disable trophies and saving, so never use them on your platinum run.

stages.text: Play the story through all five chapters. There are no mission gold medals to chase and no mission replay, so just follow the pink main-mission markers from one mission to the next. Two things matter more than anything else in this stage. First, do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only potentially missable trophy in the game, Positive Mental Attitude. Second, keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since there are 15 manual slots and no way back otherwise. While you play, scan new vehicles with WAiNK and study animals with the binoculars as you go, because the 100% checklist counts progress made during the story. Do optional missions as they appear too: several of them unlock systems other trophies need, like the Key Cloner, jewelry robberies and bank vaults.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Finish the story, watch one meditation

stages.text: After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion Checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is far more forgiving than a true 100% — closer to 60% of everything. You need any 100 optional missions (there are far more than that), any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts and any 70 of 80 challenges. The only things that need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, so put your cleanup effort there. Nothing in this stage is missable, and it can all be done after the story at your own pace.
stages.title: Stage 2 — The 100% Completion Checklist

stages.text: Strangers & Freaks and the named side questlines are not needed for 100%, so they get their own stage. Finish the 8 stranger strands that count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more — then close out the character questlines one by one: Andy (Lucia only), Kenton (treasure diving, 7 shipwrecks), Billy (Thrillbilly Mudclub), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (Jason only, Synthetic Labs) and Bret (Jason only, hunting). Cal's fishing challenge and the arcade games sit here too. Everything is still available after the story, so work through the list in any order you like.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks and side questlines

stages.text: Money and collections. Buy the 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate app ($160,000 total), launder $250,000 of marked bills through a fence, spend $100,000 in shops, register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, complete 3 collectible card sets, scan 100 WAiNK locations, discover 100 vehicles and unfog all 52 areas of Leonida. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so the money trophies fund themselves once the vaults are open.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Money and collections cleanup

stages.text: The odd jobs. Try all 9 activity types, win 20 different races, escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, drop 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, steal a plane from VCIA, steal a Rhino tank, rob a jewelry store undetected, rob an armored truck, have maximum strength with both characters, rack up 500 criminal-profile actions, and the two cryptic ones — the UFO easter egg and the Payday Loans second chance. The platinum pops with the last of them.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Odd jobs, then the platinum
